title: A work-orders-only user adding a customer from a work order sees the reps
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-B}, whose role has "Work Orders — Create & Edit" but not "Customers — Create & Edit", at {Location-A}.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR WO Only with the custom role ZZAUTOTEST SSR WO Only; {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Starting screen: the Work Orders page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Start a New Work Order and choose to add a new customer from it.
  2. Click the Sales Representative field in the New Customer window.
  3. Pick {Sales-rep-A}, fill in the required details and save the customer.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the New Customer window opens and stays open (no access-denied message), with a Sales Representative field.
  • Step 2: "Unassigned" is first, then the active sales representatives including {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 3: the customer is created with {Sales-rep-A}, and the new work order can carry on with it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R1: “The Edit Customer window and the New Customer window both show a Sales Representative field, in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the outlined box every other field in the window has.”
  • S4-R3: “Its dropdown starts with "Unassigned", followed by every staff member whose Sales Representative switch is on and whose account is active, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z, as on the work order (S1-R8). Every one of them is listed, however many there are. It has no search box (S1-R12). The same list shows when the New Customer window is opened from a part sale by a user who can create part sales but not customers.”
  • Story 4 prerequisites: “User has 'Customers — Create & Edit' enabled, or 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' when the New Customer window is opened from the work order window, as today, or 'Part Sales — Create & Edit' when it is opened from a part sale.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, Phase 3 browser walk: “From a work order → New Work Order → add customer **as a user holding only 'Work Orders — Create & Edit'**: the dialog stays open (no Access Denied) and lists reps (D14).”
